items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, and in particular at Edwina’s.

ctx.x: Yeah, and in particular at Edwina’s.

I can’t figure out the name of the street, but it was about 7th and T, Wiltberger, back, facing the theater, the Howard Theater. If you stood like the Howard Theater and you walked across the street, it was diagonally right and up in there.

items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Pissy widow, we used to call her. Pres used to like to live there – Lester Young.

ctx.x: Do you have – speaking of Washington, do you have any particular recollections of Washington, D.C.?
Yeah. Edwina’s, where you could go and eat all you want. Pissy widow, we used to call her. Pres used to like to live there – Lester Young.
